description: Bring an earlier published version back as unpublished changes (page content only — routes, menus, images and settings stay). version: a number from list_versions, or "previous". dryRun: show what would change. Then review and publish_site, or discard_drafts to undo; publish:true makes it live at once.

dryRun.description: Only list what would change; writes nothing.

keys.description: Restore only these content keys (single-page restore: CORE workspaces). Default: the whole version.

publish.description: Publish exactly the restored pages at once (live-mode sites). Default false: they stay unpublished changes.

removeAdded.description: Remove pages added since the version. Default true.

replaceDrafts.description: Replace unpublished changes on the pages the restore touches. Without it such a restore answers 409 drafts_pending.

version.description: A version from list_versions, or "previous" (the one before live).

name: restore_version
